battle_scenarios.description: Both you and your opponent get randomly generated teams with procedurally generated sets for each Pokémon. The goal is to KO all six of your opponent's Pokémon to win.
These are battles you encounter while progressing through the main storyline of the Pokémon games, such as Gym Battles, Elite Four, and Champion battles.
These battles follow specific rules and formats, such as those used in official tournaments and leagues. They often involve custom teams and strategies.
A large-scale battle where multiple players (usually 4 or more) fight simultaneously until only one Pokémon remains standing.
Battles where each player uses two Pokémon at the same time. This requires different strategies and team compositions compared to single battles.
Similar to double battles, but with three Pokémon on each side.
Each player has a team of three Pokémon, and they must rotate their Pokémon in and out of battle after every turn.
Battles that take place in the air, where only Flying-type Pokémon and those with the ability Levitate can participate.
Battles where only Bug-type Pokémon are allowed.
Battles where each player uses a team of Pokémon from the same type (e.g., all Fire-type Pokémon).
